title: Repeat-Change Share on Rental Plus Upgrade Charges
content:
**Rule.** The share of the term charged on a Rental Property Service Contracts Plus upgrade charge follows the upgrade charges already billed on the contract in the twelve months before the upgrade and the benefit authorizations issued on it in the three months before the upgrade:

| Upgrade charges billed in the 12 months before the upgrade | Benefit authorizations issued in the 3 months before the upgrade | Share |
|---|---|---|
| at least one | at least one | the whole term: one |
| at least one | none | the whole calendar months from the upgrade date to the term end date, counted down to whole months, divided by 12 |
| none | any | the calendar days from the day after the upgrade date through the term end date, divided by the term's days counted from its first day through its last day inclusive |

**Records read.** The upgrade charges in the contract's billing history, with their dates; the benefit authorizations in its claim records, with their dates; the term start and end dates on the contract.

The share multiplies the annual Plus step; the charge is rounded to the cent once at the end, never the share.

## Hypothetical contracts (upgrade on 10 August, term ending 31 January)

- An upgrade charge billed in March and a benefit authorization issued in June: share one.
- An upgrade charge billed in March, no benefit authorization since 10 May: whole months from 10 August to 31 January are 5 (10 August to 10 January), share 5 divided by 12.
- No upgrade charge in the 12 months: the days from 11 August through 31 January, 174, divided by the term's days.
